invariants.rationale: This covers the only two valid states for result at method exit.
If y is negative, getItemIndexAt(y) is likely to return -1, so result would be null, enforced by method logic.
If result is not returned as null, it implies the index is valid; otherwise, it's -1 as per method.
If result is not null, then the returned index must be valid (non-negative).
If index is not -1, result is items.get(index); otherwise, result is null.
